title: Phase 0: restore a trustworthy Biggie/Smalls authority baseline
description: Implement the first independently reviewable slice of the operator-approved MAP Research Adoption Implementation Program: establish truthful Biggie mirror and Smalls authority freshness across host and agent-sandbox execution, reconcile the remaining authority/rotation recovery evidence without weakening fail-closed writer detection, and produce a verified Phase 0 baseline packet for independent review.
acceptance_criteria: Biggie and Smalls host roles are named consistently in the new baseline artifact, with Smalls remaining the sole writable lifecycle authority and Biggie remaining a read-only mirror.

The Biggie host-side and Codex-sandbox authority probes are reproduced and distinguished with exact commands; the sanctioned route no longer gives agents a false stale result solely because the sandbox cannot access the user systemd bus, without treating an unproven writer state as clean.
A genuine active local lifecycle writer or recent overlapping watcher write still fails closed and blocks mirror installation.
Focused authority tests cover the sandbox/user-bus failure mode and the retained writer-collision protections.

Unsandboxed map-authority status and route, task mirrors, shared-state validation, focused tests, and graph runner provide a consistent final baseline, with any remaining blockers explicitly carried rather than hidden.
A different core agent performs functional review and a separate security-framed review before approval because the change affects an authority/write-capable trust boundary.
